About Us

Surrey Chauffeur Service,
Built Around The Ride.

Posh Passage Limousines exists on a simple idea: the way you arrive should feel as good as the occasion itself.

Our Story

Chauffeured Travel, Done Properly

Posh Passage Limousines was built to bring genuinely professional chauffeured travel to the Lower Mainland — not just a driver, but someone who knows the route, respects your schedule, and shows up looking the part.

We run two very different vehicles for two very different nights: a stretch limousine for the moments that call for quiet elegance, and a party bus for the ones that don't. Whatever the occasion, the standard is the same — clean vehicles, licensed chauffeurs, and a ride that starts and ends exactly when we said it would.

We're based in Surrey and drive the full stretch from downtown Vancouver to the ski hills of Whistler, so wherever your plans take you across the Lower Mainland, chances are we already know the way.

Licensed & Insured

What Sets Us Apart

Four Things We Don't Compromise On

Punctuality

We build in buffer for traffic and weather so your timeline never depends on luck.

Presentation

Spotless vehicles, pressed chauffeurs — every ride shows up looking the part.

Discretion

A party of two or a party of thirty — we'll match you to the right vehicle either way.

Our Chauffeurs

People Who Know The Route

Every chauffeur on our team is licensed, professional and genuinely familiar with the roads we run — from downtown Vancouver's one-way streets to the switchbacks on the Sea-to-Sky Highway. They're there to make the ride easy: doors, bags, timing, all handled, so you can focus on the occasion instead of the drive.

  • Professionally licensed & insured
  • Sharply presented, every ride
  • Familiar with the Lower Mainland & Sea-to-Sky routes
  • Flight-tracking for every airport pickup
  • Calm under a tight schedule
